'''Carlin''' was [[Perrin Aybara]]'s uncle. He was married to [[Neain]].

==Activities==
He lived on the Aybara farm with the rest of Perrin's family before passing away.{{ref/book|4|29}} He is now buried there.{{ref/book|4|40}}
